tagline.zh: 一行声明替代全部断点:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)) 让网格按容器宽度自动增减列数;auto-fill 保留空轨道、auto-fit 回收空轨道拉伸填满。
tagline.en: One declaration replaces every breakpoint: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)) grows and shrinks the column count with the container; auto-fill keeps empty tracks, auto-fit collapses them and stretches the rest.

origin.zh: 出自 CSS Grid Layout 的自动重复(auto-fill / auto-fit)与 minmax() 轨道:CSS-Tricks《Complete Guide to Grid》称之为「CSS Grid 中的顶级技巧之一」;auto-fill 尽量多排列(允许空轨道),auto-fit 将已有轨道拉伸填满空间(丢弃空轨道);轨道关键字还可用 minmax(10px, 1fr)、min-content、max-content(调研 05§3,原文抓取核对)。
origin.en: From CSS Grid Layout's auto-repeat (auto-fill / auto-fit) with minmax() tracks: CSS-Tricks' Complete Guide to Grid calls repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)) "one of the top tricks in CSS Grid"; auto-fill packs as many tracks as fit (allowing empty ones), auto-fit stretches occupied tracks to fill (dropping empty ones); tracks can also use minmax(10px, 1fr), min-content, max-content (research 05 §3, verified against the source).

effect.zh: minmax() 轨道最小宽度。默认 250px 取自调研 05§3 记载的经典配方 repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));容器每多出一段「min + gap」宽度就多容纳一列,这是无断点网格的全部机制。
effect.en: The minmax() track minimum. Default 250px is the classic recipe recorded in research 05 §3: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)); each extra (min + gap) of container width admits one more column — the entire mechanism of the breakpoint-free grid.

effect.zh: 轨道间距。默认 16px 取自 WebKit 官方示例(调研 05§5 记载的 grid 示例声明 gap: 16px)。gap 参与「能塞几列」的计算:间隙越大,同宽度下列数越少。
effect.en: Track gap. Default 16px from the official WebKit example (research 05 §5 records gap: 16px in the grid declaration). The gap participates in the column-fit math: larger gaps mean fewer columns for the same width.

effect.zh: 演示容器宽度(CSS 型,注入 --af-width)。800px 为本条目演示基准值——配 250px 最小轨道恰好解析出 3 条轨道,便于观察空轨道行为;生产中宽度来自真实容器。
effect.en: Demo container width (CSS-type, injected as --af-width). 800px is this entry's demo baseline — with a 250px track minimum it resolves to exactly 3 tracks, making empty-track behavior easy to observe; in production the width comes from the real container.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 切换 data-mode 重写 repeat() 关键字)。auto-fill 按容器尽量多排列并保留空轨道;auto-fit 把没有条目的轨道回收为 0 并拉伸剩余轨道——条目数少于轨道数时两者才有可见差异。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo toggles data-mode to rewrite the repeat() keyword). auto-fill packs as many tracks as fit and keeps empty ones; auto-fit collapses item-less tracks to 0 and stretches the rest — the two keywords only differ visibly when there are fewer items than tracks.

effect.zh: 渲染的条目数(JS 型)。默认 2:在 800px 容器(3 条轨道)下,少于轨道数的条目数正是 auto-fill 与 auto-fit 产生可见差异的场景——一条轨道空置 vs 被回收拉伸。
effect.en: How many items render (JS-type). Default 2: in the 800px container (3 tracks), an item count below the track count is exactly where auto-fill and auto-fit visibly diverge — one track sits empty vs gets collapsed and stretched.

note.zh: CSS Grid(含 repeat(auto-fill/auto-fit, minmax()) 与 min-content/max-content 关键字)为 Baseline Widely available:MDN 记载 grid-template-areas 同模块基线自 2017-10(调研 05§2/§3)。
note.en: CSS Grid (including repeat(auto-fill/auto-fit, minmax()) and the min-content/max-content keywords) is Baseline Widely available: MDN records the module-wide baseline since 2017-10 for grid-template-areas (research 05 §2/§3).

fallback.zh: 所有支持 Grid 的浏览器都原生支持本配方,无需回退;不支持 Grid 的极老环境会忽略网格声明,条目按块级元素纵排——保持单列可读即可。auto-fill 与 auto-fit 的取舍不是兼容性回退,而是语义选择:占位卡组用 auto-fill(轨道位置稳定),内容卡组用 auto-fit(无空档)。
fallback.en: Every Grid-capable browser supports this recipe natively — no fallback needed; on ancient non-Grid engines the declarations are ignored and items stack as blocks — a readable single column is fine. The auto-fill vs auto-fit choice is semantic, not a compatibility fallback: use auto-fill for slot-based grids (track positions stay stable) and auto-fit for content grids (no empty slots).

use.zh: 无断点卡片墙:博客列表、作品集、设置卡组——容器多宽都自动成形
use.en: Breakpoint-free card walls: blog lists, portfolios, settings card groups — they form themselves at any width

use.zh: bento 网格的基础拼装——调研 05§9:以命名区域或 auto-fit 流式网格拼装不等尺寸卡片
use.en: The base layer of bento grids — research 05 §9: assemble mixed-size cards from named areas or the auto-fit fluid grid

use.zh: 设计系统的自适应栅格容器:一份栅格吃下侧栏/主栏/弹窗等各种宿主
use.en: Design-system adaptive grid containers: one grid serves sidebars, main columns and dialogs

use.zh: 内容驱动轨道:min-content / max-content 关键字让列宽跟随内容而非猜测值(调研 05§3)
use.en: Content-driven tracks: min-content / max-content keywords size columns by content instead of guesses (research 05 §3)

avoid.zh: 必须精确控制每行列数的版面——改用 repeat(N, 1fr) 或命名区域,auto-repeat 的列数由容器决定
avoid.en: Layouts needing an exact per-row column count — use repeat(N, 1fr) or named areas; auto-repeat lets the container decide

avoid.zh: 条目高度差异巨大且顺序敏感的信息流——考虑瀑布流条目(masonry-columns / grid-lanes)
avoid.en: Feeds with wildly varied heights and sensitive order — consider masonry entries (masonry-columns / grid-lanes)

avoid.zh: minTrack 过小(<120px)让一屏塞下过多轨道,文字挤压不可读
avoid.en: minTrack too small (<120px) crams too many tracks per screen and squeezes text below readability

avoid.zh: 视觉设计依赖「第 N 个条目落在第几列」的规律——auto-repeat 的列数随容器变化,位置不可承诺
avoid.en: Designs that rely on "item N lands in column X" — auto-repeat column count varies with the container, so positions can't be promised

a11y.zh: 自动换列只改视觉位置、不改 DOM 顺序——读屏与 Tab 顺序始终等于 DOM 顺序(WCAG 1.3.2 语义顺序);若视觉重要度与 DOM 顺序不一致,用 order 或显式 grid-column 调整并同步 DOM 顺序;空轨道是纯视觉概念,不产生空白焦点目标;条目内交互控件保持可达且不依赖 hover。
a11y.en: Re-flowing columns changes visual positions only, never DOM order — screen-reader and Tab order always follow the DOM (WCAG 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence); when visual priority differs from DOM order, adjust with order or explicit grid-column and keep the DOM order coherent; empty tracks are purely visual and create no blank focus targets; interactive controls inside items stay reachable and hover-independent.

goal.zh: 用 repeat(auto-fit, minmax()) 复刻一块无断点卡片墙:容器宽度任意变化时列数自动增减,条目少于轨道数时空轨道被回收、剩余轨道拉伸填满,无媒体查询。
goal.en: Replicate a breakpoint-free card wall with repeat(auto-fit, minmax()): the column count grows and shrinks with the container, empty tracks collapse when items run out, and remaining tracks stretch — no media queries.

acceptance.zh: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(Npx, 1fr)) 严格使用参数快照值,不自行调整
acceptance.en: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(Npx, 1fr)) uses the exact parameter snapshot values

acceptance.zh: 提供 auto-fill 对照说明:空轨道保留(位置稳定)vs 回收(拉伸填满)
acceptance.en: Include the auto-fill contrast: empty tracks kept (stable positions) vs collapsed (stretch to fill)

acceptance.zh: 轨道间距使用快照 gap 值;不出现媒体查询断点
acceptance.en: Track gap uses the snapshot value; no media-query breakpoints anywhere

acceptance.zh: 条目 DOM 顺序与视觉顺序一致,交互控件可 Tab 聚焦
acceptance.en: Item DOM order matches visual order; interactive controls are Tab-focusable

acceptance.zh: 轨道最小值先给固定 px,再用 minmax() 表达,避免内容溢出轨道
acceptance.en: Declare a fixed px floor before minmax() so content cannot overflow its track
